annotations.title: Address-poisoning look-alike check against addresses you trust

description: Compare a destination address with up to 50 addresses you already trust (address book, past counterparties): catches vanity "dust attack" look-alikes with the same first and last characters. Verdict exact_match / lookalike / partial / no_match. PAID: $0.001 per call or 1 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/poison-check.
